design.identity: request_id identifies an exact pool/reference and ordered background plus entrant; event_id identifies a single-worker swap
design.k: 7,8,9,11,12,13,15,16,17,23,24,25; only consecutive values form GROWTH rows
design.selection: random candidates and backgrounds independent of class labels, target geometry and outputs
design.condition: ordinary_manual with aligned difficulty and pool_n>=27; one pool per building*difficulty

SWAPS.request_a_request_b: exact members and reference are joined from DESIGN and TEAM_RESULTS
SWAPS.B8L2_change: B minus A, null unless both scored
SWAPS.abs_B8L2_change: absolute B minus A, no imputation
SWAPS.floor_jaccard_difference: 1-IoU of two complete fusion footprints, camera-height-normalized coordinates
SWAPS.structure_bound_cyclic_deg: frozen bound cyclic top/bottom maximum angular distance; null for unequal pair counts or missing connected geometry
SWAPS.changed_coidentity_pairs: number of changed co-group relations among observations shared by both teams
SWAPS.shared_group_vote_flips: selection flips of restricted shared-observation groups; null if the shared partition changes
SWAPS.selected_shared_change: fraction of shared observations whose selected membership changes
SWAPS.edge_change: Jaccard difference of connected shared-observation adjacency relations
SWAPS.one_swap_can_flip: baseline A has a group at ceil(k/2)-1 or ceil(k/2) support; observed-team diagnostic, not historical predictor
SWAPS.stable_main: both complete, absQ<=2, floor difference<=.05, equal nodes, bound angle<=3 degrees; failure or missing required metric is false
SWAPS.Q_QT_QTD_same: old heldout-building labels equal; unknown labels remain null
SWAPS.history_9_history_12: co-membership rate learned from other buildings at the same difficulty, shrinkage5 to building-equal prior; >=6 historical pools and >=3 buildings
SWAPS.target_same_pair_count: post-answer diagnostic only; not used to select members

aggregation.primary: paired available class edges within pool/context/k; context average then image average then building equal
aggregation.continuous_missing: class edge group mean only if every edge metric is present; near/far summary uses jointly observed groups
aggregation.chains: all 12 declared nodes, not every intermediate integer; failure included as not stable
aggregation.interval: 10000 building bootstrap resamples, seed20261019, exploratory unadjusted percentile interval
aggregation.alternatives: image and experiment weighted deltas retained
aggregation.vote_gate: paired states at fixed pool/context/k; only cells with both near and clear states contribute
aggregation.growth: odd-to-even versus even-to-odd within the same nested candidate/background chain; descriptive, entrant and k also change
aggregation.Q_matched: same outgoing worker; same/cross entrants with heldout historical Q difference<=3; no target point-count gate; all feasible anchors retained, then image/building averaging

not_computed: Semi initialization/net improvement and blind-trust causal analysis
frozen_inputs: REGISTRATION input_files; source scripts restored unchanged by curated bootstrap

MECHANISM_EVENTS.identity_repartition: shared-observation co-membership changes; unavailable remains null
MECHANISM_EVENTS.node_count_change: node count differs; not a full structural-equivalence test
MECHANISM_EVENTS.selected_membership_change: any shared observation changes selected membership
MECHANISM_EVENTS.identity_and_node_change: both predicates true; either unavailable -> null
MECHANISM_EVENTS.direction_zero_gap: absolute B8 difference with only direction loss zeroed, diagnostic not new score version
MECHANISM_EVENTS.direction_gap_amplification: abs observed score gap minus direction_zero_gap; negative possible, unavailable stays null

CASE_POINT_CONTROLS.scope: 50 synthetic coordinate interventions, 6 pairs x 4 components x 2 directions plus 2 endpoints; not real teams
CASE_POINT_CONTROLS.component: pair / x(shared top and bottom) / top_y / bottom_y / all_pairs
CASE_POINT_CONTROLS.identity: original workers retained; only declared coordinates replaced by other worker; no GT coordinates used

extensions.design: each separate registration, first pool per building*difficulty, n>=27; 9 pools per layer
extensions.labels: all Q/QT/QTD/history labels unknown; no ordinary-Manual transfer
extensions.semi: final-output geometry only, not correction gain or blindness inference
extensions.counts: 648 requests and645 unique teams per layer; k25 backgrounds repeat for one n27 pool
extensions.inherit: SWAPS/GROWTH/BACKGROUNDS/TEAM_RESULTS and compare semantics same as main; subset DESIGN and REGISTRATION live in extension folder
